name: Phone app: phone at the side
when: What the in-game phone can or cannot do (a feed you can browse, a button that refuses): a generic social feed on a phone at the right, a finger scrolls it and presses +, the app refuses, the two-part caption on the left lands with it. Under it the validated clip shows the shot sharp for 4 frames, then crossfades over 16 frames to the soft, dark copy (see ground) and stays on it.
anchor: The finger presses + (`press`) on the word that says you cannot; the second half of the caption lands 2 frames later.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.line1: caption, first half (the lead-in), 28 characters at most
vars.line2: caption, second half, lands with the refusal, 22 characters at most
vars.source: source line under the caption; empty = none
vars.toast: what the app says when + is pressed, 32 characters at most
vars.app: the app's header (Feed), 10 characters at most; never a real app's name
vars.handle1: post 1 account: a made-up in-game account, never the channel or a real person
vars.pic1: post 1 picture: a 16:9 still in the project's assets/ (a trailer frame); empty = a dark tile
vars.avatar1: post 1 account picture: a small square crop in the project's assets/; empty = no circle
vars.press: seconds after the start: when the finger presses + (at least 2.8)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: The phone swings in over 15 frames instead of 22 (entry 0.5 s). Everything tied to the press (finger, button, toast, caption half 2, source) moves with `press`. The lab clip ends on the held frame; the template leaves with a 7-frame fade at `out`. The feed pictures and account pictures are the project's files (the lab used its own trailer stills). The soft shot behind it is the project's footage, baked from `ground`; its 4-frame sharp start and 16-frame crossfade are in `ground` as soft_at / soft_fade.
